about: Public repositories whose agent skills (folders holding a SKILL.md) are Marketplace workflows for every account, read from the repository itself by src/skill-sources.mjs in the shared pool: nothing is copied into this repository. Each source row names a git host row, the kind of thing the repository holds (a row in kinds; default_kind when left out), the owner, the repository, the branch and the folder its skills sit under ("" for the whole repository). Every check_every_minutes the branch's commit is read from the host (one small read, git's own reference list); only when it moved is the archive of that commit read again, so a new or changed skill appears by itself and a removed one leaves. A skill shows only when its own folder, else its repository, names an open licence (records/skill-import-rules.json). Adding a repository for every account is a row in sources (a person's AI adds one for that person alone with the skill_repositories tool); a read nobody lists for forget_after_days is forgotten; adding a git host is a row in hosts, whose addresses take {owner}, {repository}, {commit} and {path}.

skills.label: Agent skills
skills.comment: Each folder holding this file is one workflow (src/skill-rows.mjs). A kind is what a repository holds: another kind of repository whose units are folders holding a named file with front matter (name, description) and instructions is one row here, and a source row names it with kind.
